1 import SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralTriangles
2 
3 /-! The four incident subdivision triangles at each of the six original vertices. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralTriangles
6 
7 /-- The opposite endpoint in the three fixed nonedge pairs. -/
8 def opposite : Fin 6 → Fin 6 := ![1, 0, 3, 2, 5, 4]
9 
10 /-- The other four vertices in their cyclic order around a source vertex. -/
11 def fanNeighbor : Fin 6 → Fin 4 → Fin 6 :=
12   ![![2, 4, 3, 5], ![2, 4, 3, 5], ![0, 4, 1, 5],
13     ![0, 4, 1, 5], ![0, 2, 1, 3], ![0, 2, 1, 3]]
14 
15 /-- The corresponding four subdivision triangles, in the same cyclic order. -/
16 def fanTriangle : Fin 6 → Fin 4 → Fin 8 :=
17   ![![0, 2, 3, 1], ![4, 6, 7, 5], ![0, 4, 5, 1],
18     ![2, 6, 7, 3], ![0, 4, 6, 2], ![1, 5, 7, 3]]
19 
20 theorem fanNeighbor_injective : ∀ v, Function.Injective (fanNeighbor v) := by decide
21 
22 theorem fanNeighbor_ne_source : ∀ v i, fanNeighbor v i ≠ v := by decide
23 
24 theorem fanNeighbor_exhaust : ∀ v w, w ≠ v → w ≠ opposite v → ∃ i, fanNeighbor v i = w := by decide
25 
26 theorem opposite_nonedge : ∀ (kind : SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind) v,
27     ¬ kind.adjacent v (opposite v) := by decide
28 
29 theorem opposite_ne : ∀ v, opposite v ≠ v := by decide
30 
31 theorem opposite_opposite : ∀ v, opposite (opposite v) = v := by decide
32 
33 /-- A subdivision triangle never contains both ends of an opposite pair. -/
34 theorem corner_ne_opposite : ∀ t i j, corner t i ≠ opposite (corner t j) := by decide
35 
36 /-- The poles and cyclic equator count each of the six vertices once. -/
37 theorem sum_poles_equator (quantity : Fin 6 → ℝ) (v : Fin 6) :
38     quantity v + quantity (opposite v) + (∑ i : Fin 4, quantity (fanNeighbor v i)) =
39       ∑ w : Fin 6, quantity w := by
40   fin_cases v <;> simp [opposite, fanNeighbor, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
41 
42 /-- Each fan sector has precisely the source and the two successive neighboring rays. -/
43 theorem fanTriangle_vertices : ∀ v i,
44     vertices (fanTriangle v i) = {v, fanNeighbor v i, fanNeighbor v (i + 1)} := by decide
45 
46 end SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralTriangles
